notation.steps: Roman numerals relative to the tonic of the entry's mode; b = flat relative to the MAJOR scale (minor bVI = degree 6 of natural minor). Lower case = minor-family chord (min, m7, m9, madd9, m7b5 'ø7', dim '°'). 'x2' / 'x0.5' = bars (default 1). 'V/3' = 3rd in the bass (app over3), 'IV/V' = bass a whole step above the root (app overV).
notation.appSteps: Exactly the app's PROG_MENU step strings for that mode (degree quality [xBars]); import these to avoid re-parsing.
notation.mode: Primary mode of the entry (major when the family has a major chart). Existing families that also have the other mode carry it in otherMode; new entries are single-mode (the app leaves a family out of a mode it has no chart for).
notation.rank: 1 = most popular. Existing order kept from the live menu; new entries inserted by judgment (famous song-cited loops higher).

styleNote.sound: Warm Rhodes-like electric piano (closest existing voice: "epiano"), dark/soft filter, tape-style warmth; rich 7th/9th chords in close or drop voicings, not bright triads.
styleNote.tempo: Slow and laid-back: about 70-90 BPM, default ~80 (swung/behind-the-beat feel if the engine supports swing; otherwise straight at ~80).
styleNote.drums: Soft, dusty boom-bap: muted kick, gentle snare/rim, light swung hats; low volume under the keys.
styleNote.bass: Round, soft sub/electric bass on roots, not busy.
styleNote.fx: More reverb and a little delay than Pop (in the range of the R&B preset), warmth around 50-60.
styleNote.caveat: Suggested numbers are a starting point modelled on the existing jazz/rnb presets; not listened to. Loudness trim (STYLE_TRIM) must be measured by Crash.
